daily.topThemeTitle: When Outcomes Funding Outruns Its Budget
daily.topThemeBody: Texas tied 95% of community college money to results, the colleges beat projections by 20–26%, and the appropriation didn't follow — so success became a shortfall for 42 of 50 districts.
